summary_zh: 一个非自回归的System 1决策引擎，可在单次前向传播中对任意文本做出类型化选择、评分和是/否判断，覆盖100多种语言，并由路由器按请求选择合适的检查点；还支持文本、图像、语音、视频和长文档，并提供校准与预测集输出。
audience_zh: 适合需要在Python、TypeScript/Node.js或浏览器中做快速分类、优先级评分、是/否判断和多语言路由的开发者，也适合通过LangChain、LlamaIndex、CrewAI或HTTP、MCP服务集成的团队。

evidence.quote: Non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine. Typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over any text in a single forward pass, in 100+ languages, with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.

**Multilingual, non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine.** Typed decisions over 100+ languages in a single forward pass — 33 ms — trained with reinforcement learning against strictly proper scoring rules (RLCD), with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.

For TypeScript / Node.js / browser, see [`laya-ts/`](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/tree/main/laya-ts/). npm releases (`npm install laya-ts`) are published from this repository's `laya-ts-v*` release tags.

One argument puts vegaml's engine under laya's names: a frozen 0.8B reader with a small physics engine on top, so every answer carries a conformal prediction set, an abstain flag, an out-of-distribution flag and a route decided without a threshold you had to guess at. Text, images, speech and 73k-to
